title: Sign of the Product of an Array
summary: Create a function signFunc(x) that outputs 1 if x is positive, -1 if x is negative, and 0 if x equals zero.
statement: Create a function signFunc(x) that outputs 1 if x is positive, -1 if x is negative, and 0 if x equals zero. Given an integer array nums, calculate the product of all its elements and return the sign of this product as determined by signFunc.
constraints: Return zero if any element is zero.
Otherwise return one for an even number of negative elements and negative one for an odd number.
hints: The magnitude of the product is irrelevant.
A zero fixes the answer at zero; every negative factor flips the sign.
Start at positive one and negate the state for each negative value.
Multiplication signs compose exactly by these flips, avoiding overflow from forming the full product.
editorial: Multiplication signs compose exactly by these flips, avoiding overflow from forming the full product.

tests.explanation: Four negatives give a positive product sign.
The zero factor makes the product sign zero.
